14 snow compaction: the density rises with time (mass kept, depth falls)
17 road icing: rain on the asphalt froze when the surface fell below 0 °C (computed ice thickness)
18 vehicle friction changed: the contact friction factor fell on the icy road (no tyre model)
19 lake freezing: the lake water froze from its own mass (frozen budget), floating ice in the flood model
20 ice thickness computed and shown (36: ice overlay with its m legend); lake-ice milestone
21 frozen ground: soil water froze in the thermal ground columns (frozen depth reported)

22 thaw: melting started (thaw milestone), snow at 0 °C while melting
23 snowmelt: meltwater entered the flood model (melt budget = climate meltwater)
24 snowmelt flooding: flooded cells in the valley (Phase 14 runoff)
25 solar radiation: clear-sky noon irradiance absorbed by the ground (albedo, incidence, shadows)
26 surface temperature: dark asphalt warmer than grass in the sun; surface-temperature overlay °C
27 heatwave dries vegetation: crown moisture fell below its start (soil too dry to supply), never below the live floor
28 heatwave and fire: the fire model starts from the dried crowns (same water array); ignition needed a source — nothing ignited before it
29 roof snow load: snow mass × g on the roof members of the structural model (≥ 0.4 kPa applied)
30 structural response through the existing engine: failures (if any) recorded with hazard climate, the roof snow kept (water ledger closed)
31 volcano and snow: lava heat on covered cells melted snow (meltwater), ash darkened the snow
32 atmospheric removal and evaporation: vapour leaves with the air (same share), evaporation continues at low pressure, ledgers close
